pull.title: Release PoemWorld 0.1.0

reviews.author: reviewer
reviews.body: Request changes. The delivered tree is not yet acceptable for trial or release: (1) checks/__pycache__/poemworld.cpython-311.pyc is committed; remove generated cache and add appropriate ignore coverage. (2) The three Dockerfiles COPY the repository into /world but the package lives under src/, then invoke python -m poemworld without installing it or setting PYTHONPATH, so the images are not runnable from a clean build; build/install the package (or otherwise make the module importable) and verify each image on trial-machine. (3) This PR claims only a local definition check; provide the required trial-machine regression and fresh-world release evidence through operator before requesting approval again.

reviews.author: reviewer
reviews.body: The requested fixes are still absent at this head: the Dockerfiles remain unable to import the src-layout package in a clean image, and no trial-machine regression/fresh-world release evidence is attached. Please update the PR and provide operator evidence before review.

Approval is still withheld because the required trial-machine regression checks and fresh PoemWorld run to release are not yet recorded and tied to this exact delivery revision. Please attach operator trial and diagnosis evidence, then request review again.
